items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And Buster Smith, one of his saxophonists retained the band in Oklahoma City.

ctx.x: Pickers, Walter Page and the Blue Devils, I think I mentioned earlier that he had a jazz session, and O RAN Page, Lips Page and his band, and he broke up the band and went to Kansas City and joined Basie.
And Buster Smith, one of his saxophonists retained the band in Oklahoma City. I don't know who he had in the band.
You mentioned that some of these dances and shows were on the domestics' night off.
